name: Looking After The Earth
overview: Scripture reveals that God created the earth intentionally and declared it very good, entrusting mankind with a unique role to exercise dominion over all living creatures and the land itself. From the beginning, God placed Adam in the garden to tend and keep it, highlighting humanity's responsibility to care for the earth as stewards under God's authority. The command to avoid polluting the land underscores the sacredness of creation and the need for reverence in how we interact with it.
